{{DISPLAYTITLE:q-Catalan Numbers}}

=q-Catalan Numbers=

The q-Catalan numbers are polynomial q-analogs of the ordinary [[Catalan Numbers]]: each <math>C_n(q)</math> reduces to <math>C_n</math> at q = 1. Different authors track different statistics, so there is more than one family.

* Carlitz q-Catalan numbers count inversions of [[Dyck Words]] and Catalan permutations
* q-Catalan numbers (MacMahon, Krattenthaler, Gessel) enumerate Dyck words by parameters of the down set
* q-Catalan numbers (Polya, Gessel) count parallelogram polyominoes by area
